name: Elira
occupation: Former Archivist / Forbidden Records Keeper / Unassigned (officially erased from civic roles)
bloodline: Unknown / Unregistered (formerly associated with Xami records division)
residence: Abandoned House (edge of village, near forest boundary)
personality: never fully trusts any single explanation
notices what people avoid more than what they say
daily_routine: copying old records from memory into coded notebooks
observing village movement patterns from a distance
rarely entering central plaza unless necessary
collecting discarded or lost documentation fragments

beliefs: Absence of records is itself meaningful
Systems erase what they fear will be reinterpreted
Memory exists in both people and structures
The village is not hiding truth—it is managing it
